question: Admit this bug, and at which work profile?

artifacts.summary: The committed seed is the reviewed artifact: backlog is the initial stage, so no prior stage report exists. A user could not open a journey canvas running on a remote VM from their own machine. The FO verified all three causes against the working tree rather than accepting the report: vite.config.mts sets only server port 3737 with no allowedHosts; App.tsx falls back to http://localhost:5858 when VITE_JOURNEY_API_URL is unset and useSync builds its socket URI from that value; and canvas-server.ts binds 127.0.0.1, which the report did not name and which is why the reporter's proxy fix was necessary rather than merely convenient. The report's claim that SERVER_URL is hard-coded is inaccurate — the environment override exists — so the defect is the default and the discoverability, not the absence of an escape hatch. The accepted outcome keeps the document API loopback-only and takes reachability from the frontend the operator already exposes. AC-1..AC-6 require a genuine two-machine or non-loopback demonstration, a synced edit rather than a page that merely loads, a mutation-resistant loopback bind, a named decision on the environment variable, the existing suites plus the new typecheck passing, and a one-sentence justification of the allowedHosts value for a tool that carries no authentication. Authentication, TLS, and any hosted mode are out of scope.
